goes stale. `numbers` and `days` are hand-ordered because teaching order is
not a property of the dictionary.

kana_set.out_note: CONTRACTS C11.1 and data/README.md both name this file kana/strokes.json, and CONTRACTS C1.2 and C3.1 point at that path. PLAN's ownership table gives data/kana/** to workstream Ca and data/kanji/** to Cb, and Cb owns the KanjiVG pipeline, so the contract and the ownership table disagree about one file. Cb emitted it inside its own tree and asked delivery-lead to rule. Moving it is this one line plus a re-run; no code changes.
kana_set.extra_note: U+30FC, the long vowel mark. It is not in the two kana ranges, so the research report's verified 176 of 176 stays exactly 176. It is added by name because a katakana chapter that cannot show the stroke for the bar in koohii has a hole in it. KanjiVG ships it as kanji/030fc.svg.
